candidates.description: Persistent multiplayer for RimWorld 1.7: dedicated servers, shared colonies, async and live raids, escrow trading, auctions, delivery contracts, alliances, a web admin panel and a Discord bot.
candidates.readme_excerpt:
Version **0.10.4** hardens the background arbiter after a review and moves the administrator's outpost geography export into the Rimlink panel. Version 0.10.3 runs the guild battle arbiter unattended in the background. Version 0.10.2 makes guild battles work for ordinary Steam installations and ships the arbiter setup. Version 0.10.1 lets personal outposts and guild capture share one world. Version 0.10.0 added guild resource outposts that change hands automatically after a battle run by the operator's arbiter, and removes the build qualification seal: passive outposts and guild capture are now enabled by server configuration and domain-format activation. Both settings are off by default. Setup is described in the [EN](wiki/en/admins/passive-outposts.md) and [RU](wiki/ru/admins/passive-outposts.md) Wiki sources. Update the server and client mod together. The server and CLI require the qualified .NET and ASP.NET runtime **10.0.14**; source builds use SDK **10.0.403**. The packaged runtime policy requires this patch explicitly. Keep original executors and runtime installations for unfinished frozen restore plans; see the [server setup](docs/server-setup.md).

Rimlink is persistent multiplayer for RimWorld 1.7. Players run their own colonies on one planet shared through a dedicated server, and can also join a friend's colony to control the pawns assigned to them. A colony is frozen while its owner is offline, so a group can trade and send raids without being online at the same time; when both players are online, they can visit, raid or manage a colony together live. Rimlink is a clean-room project with its own protocol, server and client. It shares no code with other RimWorld multiplayer mods and does not work with them. ## What's new in 0.10.4 [Release 0.10.4](https://github.com/Asofwar/rimlink/releases/tag/v0.10.4): `arbiter run` no longer stops on a request timeout, keeps the profile while a campaign is scheduled or a battle is in hand, never starts the arbiter on a half-updated game copy, takes one owner per arbiter folder and sends the admin token only to the server certificate seen at `arbiter setup`. The administrator's **Outpost geography** export is a button in the Rimlink panel instead of a caravan command. Update the server and mod together. ## What's new in 0.10.3 [Release 0.10.3](https://github.com/Asofwar/rimlink/releases/tag/v0.10.3): `rimlink-tools arbiter setup` and `arbiter run` keep the guild battle arbiter as a background process without a window and without Steam. The command mirrors the game and the modpack's mods, lets the game generate the battle map template and capture the profile, publishes it, and restarts or refreshes the arbiter when it exits or when the game or the modpack changes. `GuildCapture:ApprovedProfileDigest` is optional now, so a new profile needs no server restart. Update the server and mod together. ## What's new in 0.10.2 [Release 0.10.2](https://github.com/Asofwar/rimlink/releases/tag/v0.10.2): a player no longer needs a byte-identical copy of the arbiter's game folder to enter a guild battle.
